classification.difficultyReason: Calculate z-scores for two examinations, compare their changes and interpret relative performance.

content.prompt:
The marks for five students in the Physics examination are shown.

In the half-yearly the mean was 60 and the standard deviation was 16.

In the yearly examination the mean was 58 and the standard deviation was 12.

inlines.text: Fill in the table, also calculate the change in the z-score. Give z-scores to 2 decimal places where necessary. Calculate each change using the displayed rounded z-scores.

answer.short:
In the order half-yearly z-score, yearly z-score, change:

Olivia: $0.69,\ 0.92,\ +0.23$.

Harriet: $-1.19,\ -1.5,\ -0.31$.

Trinity: $1.5,\ 1.83,\ +0.33$.

Hannah: $-0.56,\ 0.08,\ +0.64$.

Karla: $0.13,\ -0.5,\ -0.63$.
answer.worked:
Use $z_H=\dfrac{x_H-60}{16}$ and $z_Y=\dfrac{x_Y-58}{12}$. Calculate the change as the displayed yearly z-score minus the displayed half-yearly z-score.

Olivia:
$$\begin{aligned}z_H&=\frac{71-60}{16}\\z_H&\approx0.69\\z_Y&=\frac{69-58}{12}\\z_Y&\approx0.92\\\Delta z&=0.92-0.69\\\Delta z&=+0.23\end{aligned}$$
Harriet:
$$\begin{aligned}z_H&=\frac{41-60}{16}\\z_H&\approx-1.19\\z_Y&=\frac{40-58}{12}\\z_Y&=-1.5\\\Delta z&=-1.5-(-1.19)\\\Delta z&=-0.31\end{aligned}$$
Trinity:
$$\begin{aligned}z_H&=\frac{84-60}{16}\\z_H&=1.5\\z_Y&=\frac{80-58}{12}\\z_Y&\approx1.83\\\Delta z&=1.83-1.5\\\Delta z&=+0.33\end{aligned}$$
Hannah:
$$\begin{aligned}z_H&=\frac{51-60}{16}\\z_H&\approx-0.56\\z_Y&=\frac{59-58}{12}\\z_Y&\approx0.08\\\Delta z&=0.08-(-0.56)\\\Delta z&=+0.64\end{aligned}$$
Karla:
$$\begin{aligned}z_H&=\frac{62-60}{16}\\z_H&\approx0.13\\z_Y&=\frac{52-58}{12}\\z_Y&=-0.5\\\Delta z&=-0.5-0.13\\\Delta z&=-0.63\end{aligned}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: With reference to the z-score, which students improved the most?

answer.short: Hannah; her z-score increased the most.
answer.worked: Hannah's z-score increased from $-0.56$ to $0.08$, a change of $+0.64$. This is the greatest increase, so her relative performance improved the most.

children.label: c
children.prompt: Which students performed worse relative to the cohort in the second examination?

answer.worked: Harriet's z-score decreased by $0.31$ and Karla's decreased by $0.63$. Their lower z-scores show worse relative performance in the second examination.

children.label: d
children.prompt: Which student's performance decreased the most?

answer.short: Karla; her z-score decreased the most.
answer.worked: Karla's z-score changed by $-0.63$, compared with Harriet's change of $-0.31$. Karla had the greatest decrease in relative performance.

children.label: e
children.prompt: Which student's performance was the most consistent?

answer.short: Olivia; her z-score changed the least.
answer.worked: The magnitudes of the z-score changes are $0.23$, $0.31$, $0.33$, $0.64$ and $0.63$. Olivia's change has the smallest magnitude, $0.23$, so her relative performance was the most consistent.
